Targ. Y. II, Deut. XXV, 10.—[Y. Kidd. I, 61ᵇ bot. אתא מ׳ לטחוניא, v. צוּמּוּת.]—Esp. charity.

<cite ref="Vayikra Rabbah 34:12">Lev. R. s. 34</cite> <he>כל עמא יפלגון מצוה</he> let every one distribute charity; a. e.—Pl. <he>מִצְוָון</he>, <cite ref="M02285"><he>מִצְוָותָא</he></cite>, <he>מִצְוָותַיָּה</he>.
<cite ref="Targum Jerusalem, Deuteronomy 7:10">Targ. Y. II, Deut. VII, 10</cite>. Targ. Y. II, Num. l. c.; a. e.—Lev. R. l. c. <he>אנא שמיע דהוא עביד מ׳</he> I hear that he is charitable.

<cite ref="Vayikra Rabbah 3:1">Lev. R. s. 3</cite> <he>רעותיה דמתקרי בר מ׳</he> he desires to be called a charitable man. Y. Ber. IX, 14ᵇ bot. <he>פרוש שכמי מחזי טעין מ׳ וכ׳</he> ed. Lehm. (oth. ed. omit <cite ref="M00842"><he>מחזי</he></cite>) ‘a carrier Pharisee’, he looks as if carrying religion on his shoulder; <cite ref="Jerusalem Talmud Sotah 5:5:4">Y. Sot. V, 20ᶜ</cite> bot. <he>טעין מִצְוָתַיָּה</he>, <cite ref="Bamidbar Rabbah 9:15">Num. R. s. 9</cite> (prov.) <he>תרעא … למצותיה פתיח לאסיא</he> a gate which opens not for good deeds, will open for the physician; a. fr.
